answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 158242 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it Halal to spend interest earnings in paying of bank charges, like internet banking charges and ATM card charges etc. Please guide. Question: Is it Halal to spend interest earnings in paying of bank charges, like internet banking charges and ATM card charges etc. Please guide. Answer ID: 158242 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 599/465/SN=5/1439) According to Shariah, it is not lawful to pay interest money in paying the charges of internet banking and ATM. Bank levies these charges in return of its services which it provides to its customers. It is not a non-Shariah tax that may make it lawful to give interest money in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
